channel.title: Knowledge Recorder Updates
channel.description: Signed macOS updates for Knowledge Recorder.

item.description:
# Knowledge Recorder 1.1.69 — macOS & Windows
## macOS
- Optional **Nemotron 3 (experimental)** local speaker separation, with a checksum-verified model download and bundled native runtime. The existing engine remains the default. - Non-blocking introduction reminder after recording starts, with an option to dismiss permanently. - **Review names** in meeting notes: suggestions from German/English self-introductions, conflict warnings and repeatable corrections of transcript speaker labels. - Updated German and English help. Recording and regular transcription are preserved if speaker separation fails.
## Windows
- Matching Nemotron 3, introduction reminder and name-review workflow, with word-timed Whisper alignment and a signed portable runtime. - Nemotron runs on CPU and can be slower than real time. It remains opt-in and experimental. - Matching bilingual help, cancellation and failure handling.
## Important limits
Name suggestions require review; they are not verified identities. Summary text is not automatically rewritten. No persistent voice profiles are created. Nemotron supports up to eight voices. The existing microphone/system distinction remains: a shared room microphone is not a new multi-person room mode.
Verified on Mac Studio and Grey Iron with 226 macOS tests, 285 Windows Core tests, synthetic-audio inference/cancellation checks and Light/Dark UI screenshots. Real-meeting accuracy has not been established by these synthetic tests.
SHA256:
- `DesktopRecorder-macOS.dmg`: `eebc1972fb19a80c56c0d6e695590ca50340c9c00330add66032f722a4e86d53` - `DesktopRecorder.exe`: `d8fc370e263f7ddb324c03eeee7210e97ea8129953ff4a5e37005be5fd292941` - `DesktopRecorder-Setup.exe`: `6354e01d1386b93bf9f664fcafece9d2e6c2eebd2a2a29b2c1608d3e4760a216`

## macOS
- The collapsed mini-player strip once again sits flush with the selected screen edge. - The expanded card retains its 12-point spacing. - macOS 27 panel sizing, monitor anchoring and stable repeated collapse/expand behavior remain intact.

Platforms included: **macOS**.
### macOS - Fixed the collapsed recorder strip floating away from the screen edge. Its window now matches the narrow strip and stays 12 points from the selected edge. - Expanding and collapsing preserve the selected monitor and edge, including multi-monitor layouts. - Resizing no longer overwrites the saved widget position. Edge snapping waits until the mouse is released. - The strip retains its recording, processing, meeting-detection and saved-status indicator dots.
